MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 儿子 (érzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Home, family
   B. Is, am, are
   C. Older brother
   D. Son

2. What does the apostrophe in nǚ'ér do? (1 mark)
   A. It shows where one syllable ends and the next starts
   B. It changes the tone
   C. It means a light tone
   D. It marks a question

3. What does 东西放好 mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sit down
   B. Wash hands
   C. Put things away well
   D. Come here

4. What does 床 (chuáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kitchen
   B. Cat
   C. House
   D. Bed

5. What does 教堂 (jiàotáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Church
   B. Tomorrow
   C. Yesterday
   D. Mosque

6. What does 十 (shí) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. Three
   C. Nine
   D. Ten

7. Read the pinyin: zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Happy birthday to you!
   B. My birthday is on 5 March.
   C. My friend gives me a gift.
   D. When is your birthday?

8. Which sentence means "When is your birthday?"? (1 mark)
   A. 我们唱歌。
   B. 你生日是几月几号?
   C. 我们切蛋糕。
   D. 朋友送我礼物。

9. What clue tells you that 咖啡 is a drink in 我喝咖啡? (1 mark)
   A. The word 我
   B. The verb 吃
   C. The verb 喝
   D. The full stop

10. What does 牛奶 niúnǎi mean? (1 mark)
   A. Beef
   B. Milk
   C. Chicken
   D. Tea

11. What is scanning? (1 mark)
   A. Singing a song
   B. Looking for one particular word or fact
   C. Reading slowly word by word
   D. Drawing a picture

12. Fill the blank: 我用眼睛____。 (I use my eyes to see.) (1 mark)
   A. 说
   B. 喝
   C. 看
   D. 听

13. Read the pinyin: fēng hěn dà. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today it rains.
   B. Today there are clouds.
   C. The sun is very big.
   D. The wind is very strong.

14. What does 小 (xiǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Not
   B. Small
   C. Sun
   D. It rains

15. What does 窗户 (chuānghu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Is at, is in
   B. Window
   C. Fridge
   D. Toilet

16. What can help you work out the meaning of an unknown word? (1 mark)
   A. Clues in the words and pictures around it
   B. Nothing
   C. The colour of the paper
   D. The size of the book

17. Which Chinese word means "to be called"? (1 mark)
   A. 再见 zàijiàn
   B. 谢谢 xièxie
   C. 您好 nín hǎo
   D. 叫 jiào

18. In the character 人, which stroke is written first? (1 mark)
   A. 撇 piě
   B. 点 diǎn
   C. 竖 shù
   D. 捺 nà

19. Which word is pronounced gēge? (1 mark)
   A. 谁
   B. 家
   C. 哥哥
   D. 爱

20. How many strokes does 妈 have? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 8

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I love you." (2 marks)

22. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 水果 and 蔬菜. (2 marks)

23. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my older sister." and "Who is this?" (4 marks)

24. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: yǔ hěn dà. (2 marks)

25. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bathroom is beside the garden." (3 marks)

26. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my younger brother." (2 marks)

27. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "When is your birthday?" (3 marks)

28. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my older sister." (2 marks)

29. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 祝 and 电视. (2 marks)

30. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The weather is very good today." (3 marks)

31. A picture shows a girl but the label says 儿子. Is the pair 对 or 错? Explain. (2 marks)

32. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is on the table." (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Son
   儿子 (érzi) means son.

2. A — It shows where one syllable ends and the next starts
   The apostrophe separates nǚ and ér.

3. C — Put things away well
   东西 is things and 放好 is put away well.

4. D — Bed
   床 (chuáng) means bed.

5. A — Church
   教堂 (jiàotáng) means church.

6. D — Ten
   十 (shí) means ten.

7. A — Happy birthday to you!
   zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! is 祝你生日快乐!, which means "Happy birthday to you!".

8. B — 你生日是几月几号?
   你生日是几月几号? (nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?) means "When is your birthday?".

9. C — The verb 喝
   喝 means to drink.

10. B — Milk
   牛奶 is milk; 牛肉 is beef.

11. B — Looking for one particular word or fact
   Scanning finds a specific detail.

12. C — 看
   看 is to see.

13. D — The wind is very strong.
   fēng hěn dà. is 风很大。, which means "The wind is very strong.".

14. B — Small
   小 (xiǎo) means small.

15. B — Window
   窗户 (chuānghu) means window.

16. A — Clues in the words and pictures around it
   Context gives clues.

17. D — 叫 jiào
   叫 (jiào) means to be called.

18. A — 撇 piě
   撇 before 捺.

19. C — 哥哥
   哥哥 is pronounced gēge and means older brother.

20. A — 6
   女 has 3 strokes and 马 has 3.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我爱你。 wǒ ài nǐ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: 水果: shuǐguǒ, fruit (as a group). 蔬菜: shūcài, vegetables.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: 这是我姐姐。 zhè shì wǒ jiějie. 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: The rain is heavy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: 那是我弟弟。 nà shì wǒ dìdi.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我姐姐。 zhè shì wǒ jiějie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: 祝: zhù, to wish. 电视: diànshì, television.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: 今天天气很好。 jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 错 (wrong). 儿子 means son, but the picture shows a girl.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying 错 and 1 mark for the reason.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.
